paper_cards.title: Can 4D Foundation Models Remember?
paper_cards.data: PersistBench uses 360-degree videos as omniscient references for objects that leave and re-enter the camera field of view.
paper_cards.method: Object-centric metrics evaluate permanence, motion continuity, and appearance preservation against panoramic ground truth.
paper_cards.task: Measure whether camera-controllable video and 4D reconstruction models retain off-screen object state.
paper_cards.novelty: Separates visual memory from short-term pixel consistency using reference-backed off-screen tests.
paper_cards.evidence: Primary paper and official project report broad degradation once objects leave view; data, code, benchmark media, and comparisons are exposed on the project page.

claim_checks.claim: 360-degree video provides omniscient benchmark ground truth
Project exposes dataset/code and benchmark examples

paper_cards.limitations: Object tracking and panorama capture constrain scenario coverage; results are author-reported.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Direct persistent-state and revisit-memory benchmark for interactive world models.

paper_cards.title: FAMOS: Feed-Forward 3D Articulation Modeling from Sparse Observations
paper_cards.data: PartNet-Mobility, ACD, ArtiCraft-10K, and procedurally generated self-annotated articulated assets.
paper_cards.method: A multi-state articulation transformer alternates state-wise and global attention and predicts movable-part segmentation, joint type, axis, origin, and observed motion span.
paper_cards.task: Infer executable articulation from a sparse unordered set of partial point clouds.
paper_cards.novelty: Uses multi-state evidence in a feed-forward variable-view model rather than relying on a single-view category prior or test-time optimization.
paper_cards.evidence: Primary paper reports consistent improvements over feed-forward and optimization baselines; official page provides moving comparisons and architecture/results panels.

claim_checks.claim: Supports variable inputs including one view
Official comparison videos show multi-state articulation recovery

paper_cards.limitations: Evaluation centers on object articulation datasets, not full cluttered scenes or downstream manipulation success.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Supplies MovablePart, JointAxis, JointOrigin, MotionRange, and multi-state evidence fields.

paper_cards.title: Agile-WAM: An Agile Tactile World Action Model for Contact-Rich Robot Control
paper_cards.data: Nine simulated and five real contact-rich manipulation tasks with synchronized vision, tactile observations, and actions.
paper_cards.method: A compact shared latent jointly generates action chunks plus future visual/tactile latents; multi-horizon supervision matches slower visual and abrupt tactile dynamics.
paper_cards.task: High-frequency contact-rich robot control with explicit multimodal future prediction.
paper_cards.novelty: Shows a tactile WAM need not use a large video generator when modality-specific prediction horizons capture contact dynamics.
paper_cards.evidence: Paper reports 29.4% relative real-task success gain at 11.9 ms latency; official project includes real task videos, recovery cases, architecture, tables, and ablations.

claim_checks.claim: Five real tasks and 11.9 ms inference latency
Official videos cover gear, plug, cable, and peg tasks

paper_cards.limitations: Small trial counts and task-specific tactile hardware limit claims about broad VLA generality.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Strong reference for typed tactile state, multi-timescale world prediction, recovery, and contact validators.

paper_cards.title: FunArt: Decoding Functional Structure and Articulation from Generative 3D Latents
paper_cards.data: Articulate3D posed RGB-D observations in a single static configuration.
paper_cards.method: Object instances are fused into TRELLIS.2 O-Voxel latents; a query decoder jointly predicts movable parts, functional elements, motion type, axis, origin, and range.
paper_cards.task: Construct articulation-aware functional 3D scene graphs before physical interaction.
paper_cards.novelty: Decodes actionable articulation and functional interaction elements directly from a frozen generative 3D prior.
paper_cards.evidence: Paper reports gains of 1.5 AP50 for movable parts, 2.8 AP50 under joint constraints, and 6.7 AP50 for functional elements over the strongest end-to-end baselines.

claim_checks.claim: Jointly estimates movable parts, functional elements, and kinematics

paper_cards.limitations: No official code/project page found; benchmark evidence is author-reported and manipulation utility is not directly evaluated.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Direct schema reference for FunctionalElement, MovablePart, JointType, Axis, Origin, and Range.

paper_cards.title: Astronex-World 1.0: Real-Time Interactive World Model Foundation
paper_cards.data: Mixed camera/action-controlled video data across first- and third-person worlds, with released training assets and model weights.
paper_cards.method: Wan2.2-based bidirectional and block-causal models use pose-aware rotary encoding, a 64-D action stream, KV caching, few-step distillation, and asymmetric distribution matching.
paper_cards.task: Generate persistent text/image-initialized interactive video under camera trajectories, continuous actions, embodiment IDs, and inserted text events.
paper_cards.novelty: Packages full-context generation and real-time causal streaming in a small openly released controllable world-model family.
paper_cards.evidence: Paper reports 832x480 at 24 FPS, WBench Navi 73.5 and Full 70.0; official project exposes extensive navigation, action, robotics, driving, and event-control videos plus code and weights.

claim_checks.notes: Official repository and Hugging Face links found.

paper_cards.limitations: Video worlds do not guarantee executable geometry or physical correctness; comparative claims are author-reported.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Open baseline for controllable real-time world generation, event injection, and action/camera interfaces.

paper_cards.title: Universal Navigation Interface: Robot-Free Data for Wheeled Robot Navigation
paper_cards.data: 37.2 km of smartphone and rollator-walker demonstrations with recovered metric trajectories.
paper_cards.method: A physically constrained human-operated rollator acts as a low-cost proxy whose feasible paths directly supervise goal-conditioned wheeled navigation.
paper_cards.task: Collect robot-free navigation data and transfer learned policies to powered wheelchairs.
paper_cards.novelty: Builds embodiment feasibility into the collection device instead of filtering unconstrained human trajectories afterward.
paper_cards.evidence: Paper reports 17.4-24.8% lower trajectory error on held-out UNI data and closed-loop wheelchair transfer; official page provides dataset, assembly, replay, and robot videos.

claim_checks.claim: Official page exposes dataset and execution videos

paper_cards.limitations: Navigation-only and wheeled-feasibility bias; cross-dataset benefits vary.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Reusable pattern for low-cost embodiment-constrained data collection and sim/real navigation evaluation.

paper_cards.title: BinoGen: Scaling egocentric binocular data for embodied visual perception and learning
paper_cards.data: More than 20 million synchronized binocular images with depth, flow, normals, semantic maps, object coordinates, and camera poses.
paper_cards.method: Automated scene synthesis, probabilistic object placement, appearance randomization, trajectory generation, and configurable binocular observer rigs.
paper_cards.task: Generate embodiment-aware egocentric visual experience for perception training and controlled embodiment studies.
paper_cards.novelty: Jointly varies world content and observer morphology while retaining dense paired supervision.
paper_cards.evidence: Paper reports consistent real-world gains for depth, detection, and tracking plus controlled human/mouse observer experiments.
paper_cards.limitations: No official project/code surface found; synthetic-to-real gains and availability require follow-up before reproduction.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Large source for ObserverEmbodiment, BinocularRig, Trajectory, DenseGeometry, and controlled perception evaluation.

paper_cards.title: SlugTrails: An Egocentric Benchmark for Floor Plan Localization in Large Buildings
paper_cards.data: 30 Hz Aria recordings across three campus buildings, six floors, and 22,089 square meters of floor-plan outline with surveyed alignment.
paper_cards.method: Three protocols unify single walking frames, stationary multi-view sweeps, and odometric walking streams against CAD-derived semantic floor plans.
paper_cards.task: Benchmark egocentric floor-plan localization in large public buildings.
paper_cards.novelty: Moves evaluation from small residences to deployment-scale buildings under multiple limited-FOV sensing regimes.
paper_cards.evidence: Five systems are evaluated; stock checkpoints are nearly zero while fine-tuning improves all trainable families and transfers to LaMAR; dataset, tools, and protocols are released.

claim_checks.claim: Dataset spans 22,089 square meters and three sensing protocols

paper_cards.limitations: Only three buildings and six floors; performance remains low in the hardest single-frame setting.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Hard spatial-memory/localization benchmark for persistent embodied agents and map-grounded reasoning.

paper_cards.title: Workspace Models: Lightweight Robotic Memory via Saliency-Driven Supervision
paper_cards.data: Memory-intensive simulation and Franka hardware manipulation tasks with VLM-generated saliency supervision.
paper_cards.method: Train-time VLM queries identify task-salient current/history sets, then a set-reconstruction objective distills them into a lightweight workspace token used at deployment.
paper_cards.task: Provide long-term robotic memory without online VLM reasoning or full-history conditioning.
paper_cards.novelty: Moves expensive saliency reasoning to training and deploys a compact learned memory token.
paper_cards.evidence: Primary paper reports better policy performance and lower deployment overhead than full-history or online-VLM memory variants.

claim_checks.notes: Primary paper; execution quality not independently inspectable.

paper_cards.limitations: No official project, code, or execution-video surface was found; visual quality cannot be judged confidently.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Strong persistent memory and task-salient state-compression primitive for long-horizon policies.
